## Meridian Tidal Pilot - Final Operations Review Summary

**Equipment failure:** Turbine T-4 suffered a bearing seal corrosion failure on 14 March 2025, allowing seawater into the nacelle. The root cause was traced to **corrosion of the bearing seal housing**, causing a multi-week outage—unique among all turbine failures during the pilot.

**Energy delivered:** The 24-month pilot delivered **18.7 GWh** to the grid, falling **6% short** of the forecasted 19.9 GWh.

**Budget:** Final project cost reached **€41.25 million** against an approved budget of €36.7 million—a **€4.55 million overrun (12.4%)**, primarily driven by the T-4 repair campaign.

**Environmental finding:** An independent fish-monitoring programme compared migration counts before and after installation and found **no statistically significant change** (p = 0.41), indicating no adverse ecological impact on fish populations.

**Recommendation:** Lead engineer **Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing the titanium fastener set with duplex stainless steel** on all remaining nacelles to prevent similar corrosion—a change the steering group accepted in principle.

**Final decision:** The **steering group approved Phase 2** for Q3 2026, contingent on completing the bearing seal redesign and a successful dry-dock endurance test.
